thread:
maria_support: Heads up — NovaPulse onboarding: API key is visible in console but their requests immediately return 402 Billing Required: 'billing_project_missing'. Provision logs show key created but billing_project=null.
aj_engineer: Can you paste the token/masked id and any provisioner logs? I'll start checking the onboarder job.
maria_support: Token masked: sk-live-***abc. Console project shows 'novapulse-prod'. Audit: provisioner created key_id=kp_12345 tenant=novapulse metadata.billing_project="".
deploy-bot: ```ProvisionerJob kp_12345 status=completed
metadata: service_account=onboarder-v2, billing_project_id=""
created_at=2026-03-12T16:22:09Z```
aj_engineer: I see it — onboarder attempted to call Billing API but got a 504 on assign call. The code path currently treats billing assignment as best-effort and proceeds, leaving billing_project empty. Runtime validates billing_project and rejects requests.
ops_julia: Confirmed — Billing API had a transient regional outage ~16:22Z for ~40s. Onboarder doesn't retry on timeout for the billing assignment step. We'll need to make that operation idempotent + retry.
customer_success_bryan: Customer already started integration tests in prod and they're blocked. They reported blank billing info in console. Need manual remediation and a short timeline.
aj_engineer: Short term I can manually attach billing_project to kp_12345 via admin CLI (will record audit). Long term: patch onboarder to mark key state 'pending_billing' if assignment fails and queue background retries (3x) plus alerting when billing_project null on creation. Also add a migration to scan recent keys.
maria_support: Please attach now and DM me when done so I can tell NovaPulse. Also add a step in the CS playbook for manual attach.
aj_engineer: Manual attach complete. CLI output: success: attached billing_project_id=b-prod-456 -> kp_12345 (audit=aj_engineer 2026-03-12T17:01:02Z). Customer should be unblocked. I'll open PR for retry logic + a small monitoring rule.
maria_support: :thumbsup: Updating customer and adding a note to the ticket. I'll include the audit id.
aj_engineer: PR opened: github.com/redwood/onboarder/pull/1425 — includes migration to scan keys from last 48h and a retry queue. Will monitor for any other null billing_project cases.
maria_support: Thanks — marking P1 until migration runs and SLO for billing-assign retries is in place.
